GETTING STARTEDUSER ACCOUNT

User Account

Your CrossTrade account is platform-aware. A switcher at the top of the left navigation flips the dashboard between NinjaTrader 8 and Tradovate, and the platform tools follow that choice: Home, Webhooks and the rest load the version built for your broker. Tools that do not apply to the broker you picked are hidden rather than greyed out, so what you can click always matches what is actually available.

One switcher decides the top half of your nav. The bottom half never changes.

TOOL	NINJATRADER 8	TRADOVATE
Home	✅	✅
Webhooks	✅	✅
Journal	✅	✅
Account Manager	✅	✅
Trade Copier	✅	✅
AI Trading	✅	✅
API Playground	✅	✅
Signal Share	✅	—
CrossTrade VPS	✅	—

Signal Share rides the CrossTrade NT8 Add-On, and the VPS is a Windows machine whose whole purpose is running NinjaTrader, so neither has a place in Tradovate mode. Everything else below the platform section (Updates, Affiliates, Help Docs, TradingView Tools, My Account) is identical on both.

Home​

Your account overview for the selected platform: open positions, active accounts, platform health, updates, and quick links into the docs.

Webhooks​

A webhook routes to NinjaTrader 8 or Tradovate based on its destination, so this section is fully live on both. It holds Master Controls (kill switch, closing-only mode, trading window), the Webhook Trader for firing a command straight from the dashboard, ready-made Command Examples, Alert History, and the Command Builder.

Webhooks →

Journal​

Every fill from both brokers in one trade log, with the Tradovate side swept server-side from your linked accounts.

Journal →

Account Manager​

Profit and loss thresholds, trading windows, end-of-day auto-flattening, minimum profit threshold and trailing drawdown, applied per account by a monitor that watches it for you.

Account Manager →

Trade Copier​

Copies between your NinjaTrader 8 accounts, or between your Tradovate accounts. Pick a copy mode (Order or Execution on NinjaTrader 8; Signal, Execution or Order on Tradovate) and add Stealth Mode, Symbol Replacement or Trade Inversion.

Trade Copier →

My Account​

Subscription and plan changes, your webhook URL, your Secret Key, broker links for Tradovate Live and Demo, and the trading safeguards: Auto-reconnect and Data Watchdog, Opposing Position Protection, and the account Visibility Manager.

Trial, paid checkout and cancellation​

The seven-day account trial starts when you sign up, not when you place your first trade. It does not automatically buy a subscription at expiry. Without a paid plan, you move to Free; your existing Journal remains available, while automatic broker imports and trading features require an eligible subscription or trial.

Choosing a paid plan is a separate purchase. Do not assume that an account trial date postpones a paid checkout's charge. Check the amount due now, billing interval and renewal date shown at checkout. If you expected a trial but received a charge, send support your signup email, receipt date and the offer you saw so they can review the actual payment record. The in-app assistant cannot issue a refund or infer an entitlement from the trial badge alone.

In My Account, use Manage Plan to open billing when it is available. It is not shown in every status, including trial, expired, canceled and past-due states; its absence does not by itself prove that you have no subscription. See Plans opens available purchase options.

Downgrading means the subscription is canceled but access remains until the displayed Access until date, after which the account moves to Free. It does not mean cancellation is still waiting for a button click. If the status, renewal or receipt disagrees with what you expected, contact support rather than buying a second subscription to fix it. VPS billing is separate from the CrossTrade tools subscription.

Where is my API token? Is it the same as my Secret Key?​

For the account-key REST API, yes. Open My Account → Security, then Reveal or Copy under Secret Key. Webhooks put it in key=...;; REST uses Authorization: Bearer .... REST access still needs an eligible plan. MCP uses a separate OAuth connection and scoped tokens. Authentication explains the formats and what changes when you regenerate the account key.

Mask account numbers​

If you record or stream your screen, you can hide your account numbers without hiding the accounts. Open Manage Accounts (My Account → General, under Account Visibility, or the accounts icon on Home) and turn on Mask account numbers.

The firm prefix stays. CrossTrade keeps the leading letters and hides the rest, so PROP1234 shows as PROP••••.
Choose how much shows. The pencil on any row in Manage Accounts sets how many characters stay visible for that account when masked. Leave it empty to keep the firm prefix automatically.
Hover to check. Hovering a masked account in Manage Accounts shows its real name.
Nicknames and simulation accounts are left alone. A nickname still shows as you set it, and Sim and Playback accounts (such as Sim101) are never masked.

Masking applies on the web dashboard, across the Account Manager, the Trade Copier, your live positions and orders, and the Journal. It changes only what is displayed: webhooks, commands and the API still use the full account name.

CrossTrade VPS​

A Chicago-based Windows VPS with NinjaTrader 8 and the add-on preinstalled. NinjaTrader only: Tradovate runs in the cloud, so it does not need one.
